question:
**Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement required'.**

Which planet is __most closer__ to the sun?
solution:
The correct answer is:** the closest**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **'More'** is considered a comparative form
 
• **'More' **refers to a larger amount or degree
 
 
• **Example -** She advised him to be **more **care
